name: Laboratory Safety & Basic Lab Skills
summary: How to work safely with chemicals and carry out and record basic laboratory measurements.

topics.name: Lab rules, personal protective equipment and emergency equipment
GHS hazard classes, pictograms, labels and Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
Risk assessment (RAMP: recognize, assess, minimize, prepare)
Handling flammables, corrosives, oxidizers and toxic substances
Fume hoods, ventilation and occupational exposure limits
Glassware, volumetric equipment and balances: accurate measurement
Basic techniques: filtration, decantation, simple distillation and titration
Lab notebook keeping and data recording
Household and kitchen chemical safety (dangerous mixtures such as bleach and ammonia)
